title: eriogonum umbellatum var. ternatum
intro: Eriogonum umbellatum var. ternatum, commonly known as Desert Unicornroot or Bottlebrush Sage, is a flowering plant native to the western United States and Canada. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and potentially treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Eriogonum umbellatum var. ternatum include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal effects.
